text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You're number one among all Umamusume, 
Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Looks like I won somehow.
choice_data_list:
Considering that, she doesn't seem very 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, but... how should I put 
it, it just hasn't really sunk in yet, or 
something...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My head felt light and floaty, my whole 
body did too, and it felt like, 'Is this a 
dream?'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it would be quite troubling if you 
made it all out to be a dream, wouldn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd be troubled if you thought it were a 
dream. I would like you to etch it firmly 
into your heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today, you finished ahead of Symboli 
Rudolf herself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Me... running ahead of the Prez...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am truly delighted to see you fulfill 
your ambition of reaching the summit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More than that, though, right now it just 
hurts. The fighting spirit boiling inside 
me feels ready to burn me to ashes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I really want to beat such a 
supreme Umamusume as Tokai Teio. That 
feeling consumes me completely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
O "Emperor." I will take back the throne 
at the pinnacle one day without fail. Wash 
your neck and wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! I won't lose next time either, 
absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is... praising me more than 
anyone else!
choice_data_list:
Go show them what a winner looks like one 
more time!

Show them what a winner looks like one 
more time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I am the "Emperor" of Umamusume!! The 
great Tokai Teio herself!!
